The lowest reported values in the evidence set (ranolazine 35-50%; rivastigmine 36% at 3 mg) are still well above the 20% threshold, so even a conservative transfer does not support F <20%.

The query's high TPSA, low logD, and strong basic pKa raise permeability uncertainty, but these descriptors are not affirmative evidence of F <20%; several high-F contexts contain ionizable basic amines.
